answer: Sybil crews flood attestation with disposable aliases. An applicant mills a 2.4 kg marble sighting disc (lot MH-4417), seats it in hollow post H-19, and logs a 14.2 km horizon bearing to beacon B-7. Verifiers open 3 of 7 sealed grind marks at random with the disc key and re-sight the horizon; all three must sit within 0.08 degrees of the epoch-beacon recomputation. A miss slashes 40% of the 8,500-token bond locked in that hollow post and bars the name for 9 epochs. Eighty aliases would tie 680,000 tokens and risk 272,000 on the first bad sighting; a farm cannot hide behind one wallet.
